test_successful_run: test the CancellationExampleTest to verify the gRPC client-server cancellation example runs successfully
test_graceful_sigint: test the CancellationExampleTest to verify the gRPC client handles SIGINT gracefully without crashing the server
run_get_port: run the _get_port context manager to allocate an ephemeral IPv6 socket port with SO_REUSEPORT
run_start_client: run the _start_client function to spawn a gRPC client subprocess with configurable server and distance arguments
review_CancellationExampleTest: review the CancellationExampleTest class and its test methods for gRPC cancellation behavior
